meta.name: The Aam Aadmi Family Season 2
meta.description: This show revolves around a middle-class Sharma family. There's a gossip-loving grandmother, a hardworking father, a sanskaari mom, and two grown up kids who are dealing with their middle-classness in the best way possible.

videos.title: Hulchul
videos.overview: Mr Sharma comes home to surprise his family but will he be able to?

videos.title: Mirch Masala
videos.overview: Mrs Sharma challenges Sonu and Bobby to run the house for a day. But will they be able to do so?

videos.title: Ram Leela
videos.overview: Bobby wants to go for a Goa trip. But Mr Sharma declines his request and humiliates him. Bobby's only chance at redemption is the Ram Leela function. What will he do?

videos.title: Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa
videos.overview: Sonu's boyfriend proposes to her, but she is in a dilemma. Will she marry him?

videos.title: Dulha Mil Gaya
videos.overview: Sonu's boyfriend comes home to meet her parents. But the Sharma family already have a prospective groom waiting for her. What will happen next?

videos.title: Shaadi Ke Side Effects
videos.overview: The wedding preparations have begun. So join in the fun of Sonu's Mehendi and Sangeet ceremonies.

videos.title: Shaadi No.1
videos.overview: Sonu's big day is finally here. But her wedding does not go as planned. What's in store for her?
